title: Vyom-205M: Official Benchmark Verification Suite & Evaluation Results
description: Official benchmark evaluation results, reproduction harness, confusion matrices, and research preprint for Vyom-205M: A 204.96M-parameter sovereign Earth observation foundation model engineered for smallholder cadastral boundary delineation, all-weather SAR-to-optical cloud penetration, and 6-class biophysical crop stress diagnostics.
